metaDescription: Kevin cites a text warning 'if you see any report that I killed myself, I most definitely did not' and compares it to David Wilcock.
summary: Kevin reads a text in which a woman told business partner Samuel Reed that if he sees any report she killed herself, she most definitely did not. He compares it to David Wilcock, who Kevin says did a three-hour livestream saying he would never take his own life before allegedly doing so. Kevin asks viewers in the chat whether they think Wilcock did it, and says he doubts it.
